name: Lap of the Gods
source:
When the sun shines on the Lap of the Gods, it is blood red. And when it rains, the sky sobs. Explore a strange world populated by even stranger beings in this story-driven adventure as Marion attempts to undo a mistake on a universal level, before everything she has ever known becomes Undone.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3138230/Lap_of_the_Gods_A_Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当阳光照在诸神膝上时，它是血红色的。下雨的时候，天空会哭泣。在这场由故事驱动的冒险中，探索一个陌生的世界，里面充满了更奇怪的生物，玛丽昂试图在她所知道的一切都被撤销之前，在普遍层面上纠正一个错误。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3138230/Lap_of_the_Gods_A_Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
